purpose: Development interpretation evaluation; not held-out validation
selection: Twenty previously inspected passages from four development claims; selected for retrieval analysis, not representative accuracy estimation
hash_convention: SHA-256 of UTF-8 JSON with ensure_ascii=False, sort_keys=True, separators=(',', ':'); each input_sha256 hashes its input object
context_policy: Other passages from the same policy, procedure, interview or meeting; same-section context only for internal communications; no neighbouring CSV rows
limitations: Four claim groups; passage pairs are not independent samples.
Retrieval selection does not establish an evidence relationship.
Source context is supplied for interpretation, not independent votes.
Relationship scoring alone does not assess applicability or credibility.
